pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 6.g3 a6 7.Bg2 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted knights via Nde2-f4 or Nf1-g3 as single routes. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 6.g3 a6 7.Bg2 Nf6 8.O-O Bc5
pages.notes: Plan 1 supported the centre with c2-c4 through the c3-knight. Rewrote plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 6.g3 a6 7.Bg2 Nf6 8.O-O Be7 9.Re1
pages.notes: Plan 4 traded 'light-squared bishops' with ...Bxd4, which the dark-squared e7-bishop cannot play. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 6.Be3 a6 7.a3
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote development as 'Bd2/f1, 0-0'; plan 2 wrote ...0-0. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 6.Be3 a6 7.Bd3
pages.notes: Plan 4 used a ...Nf6-e8-g7 manoeuvre into Black's own g7-pawn. Plan 4 is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-26 (reviewer: first draft had ...Bc5 hitting the e3-bishop after Bxd4).

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 6.Be3 a6 7.Bd3 Nf6 8.O-O Bd6
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f2-f4-f5 as one route; plan 4 played ...d6-d5 with the bishop on d6 blocking the d-pawn. Rewrote plans 1 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 6.Be3 a6 7.Be2 Nf6 8.O-O Bb4 9.Na4 Be7
pages.notes: British spelling in plan 3. Plan 2 (light-square control of d5 after Nxc6) is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-26 (reviewer: the c6- and e6-pawns cover d5 after either recapture).

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 6.Be3 a6 7.Be2 Nf6 8.O-O Bb4 9.Na4 Be7 10.Nxc6
pages.notes: Plan 1 targeted a c6-pawn with a minority attack before Black has recaptured; plan 2 put the bishop on b7 behind the c6-pawn. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling in the overview. Plan 4 is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-26 (reviewer: Na4-c5 runs into the e7-bishop and ...d6).

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 6.Be3 a6 7.Be2 Nf6 8.O-O Bb4 9.Na4 O-O
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Bxc3 when the knight has gone to a4; plan 1 challenged the bishop with c4, which doesn't attack b4. Rewrote plans 1-2.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f4-f5 with the f3-knight blocking the f-pawn. Rewrote plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, Four Knights, 6.Nxc6 bxc6 7.e5 Nd5
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-23: plan 1 (a knight route Ne2-c3 for the knight already on c3) was rewritten twice and rejected twice (Bc4 runs into ...cxd5; Ne4 does not attack d5). Old text kept.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 5...a6 6.Be2 Nge7
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-23: plan 1 rewritten with the e7-knight going to g6, or to c6 after an exchange on d4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 5...a6 6.Be3 Nge7
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-23: plan 3 rewritten without the c8-knight supporting ...b5.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 6.g3 a6 7.Bg2 d6
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-23: plan 3 rewritten so the c-file rook aims at c3 and the queenside, not the d4-knight.
